source_file: Simple method to check if variable exists in a dataset.sas
notes: The %varexist(in=) macro (dictionary.columns lookup for an EPOCH variable, then a conditional PROC SORT that drops it if present) is unmodified. The repo had no caller (in=ex referenced a dataset that does not exist anywhere in the repo), so a small caller was written: a mock ex dataset with usubjid + epoch columns, matching the clinical-trials-style variable names the macro's own logic implies. Confirmed: dictionary.columns correctly finds EPOCH (VARCOUNT=1), the epoch-present branch fires, and ex1 is written with epoch dropped (columns: usubjid only).
